api_token.description: Optional PVE API token (format: user@pve!token_name!token_uuid); use instead of password when possible

auth_url.description: Base URL for the PVE API endpoint (include full path)

cluster.description: Name of the Proxmox VE cluster (used for node identification)

domain.description: Optional login domain for Kerberos or Active Directory authentication

ipaddr.description: Optional IP address or hostname to use for fencing; overrides DNS resolution

password.description: Password for the PVE user (required unless using API token)

ssl_ca_path.description: Optional path to a custom CA bundle file for SSL verification

ssl_verify.description: If true (1), verify the PVE server's SSL certificate; if false (0), skip verification (not recommended for production)

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for fence action to complete
